About Driftlane

Driftlane

A fast, keyboard-first kanban board you can run by opening a single HTML file. No accounts, no servers, no build step — just columns, cards, and drag-and-drop that actually feels good.

What's inside

Real drag-and-drop

Hand-written with Pointer Events — a lifted ghost, a live insertion placeholder, cross-column moves and column reordering. Works with mouse, touch and pen.

Rich cards

Labels, assignees with generated avatars, due dates, priority, comment counts and checklists with a live progress bar. Click any card to edit everything.

WIP limits & stats

Per-column work-in-progress limits flag overload, while a stats rail shows cards per column, percent complete and a rolling activity log.

Search & filter

Live search plus filters for label, assignee and priority, and a "my cards" toggle — the board re-flows instantly as you type.

Local autosave & I/O

The whole board persists to localStorage and restores on load. Export and import boards as JSON, or reset to the sample sprint at any time.

Keyboard-first

Tab through cards, open with Enter, and move cards between columns with the arrow keys — no mouse required. Press ? for the full list.

Keyboard shortcuts

  • /  focus the search box
  • N  quick-add a card to the first column
  • Tab  move focus between cards · Enter opens the focused card
  • ← →  move the focused card to the previous / next column
  • ↑ ↓  reorder the focused card within its column
  • F2 or double-click  rename a column
  • Esc  close a dialog or cancel · ?  toggle the shortcut help

How it's built

Driftlane is intentionally dependency-free. There is no React, no drag-and-drop library, no bundler. The data layer (data.js) holds the board, seed content and persistence; render.js turns state into DOM; dnd.js implements drag-and-drop from scratch on top of Pointer Events; modal.js is the card editor; and board.js wires it all together. Everything respects prefers-reduced-motion and works offline over file://.
